title: MECHANICS OF MATERIALS
description: Determination of stresses, deflections, and stability of deformable bodies with an introduction to finite element analysis.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (ENGR 213 or 213H) and (MTH 256 or 256H).
A minimum grade of C is required in ENGR 213, ENGR 213H, MTH 256 and MTH 256H.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
